about: Sample sizes used by build_pack.py, by the final risk score (after any auditor override). The ranges follow the council's Table 4 bands (Low up to 3, Moderate 4-6, Medium - High 8-12, Extreme 15-25), widened so every score 1-25 falls in exactly one range. Sizes are the builder's default reading, not a council figure: the auditor may change 'units'; the planner must not edit this file.
source: build_pack default (auditor to confirm or change)
